description: This Dart source file defines a factory class 'ChatServiceFactory' responsible for creating instances of 'ChatService' based on available API keys or fallback to a mock service. It involves logic to determine whether to use in-app stored keys, build-time configured keys, or default to a mock implementation.

classes.name: ChatServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static method to create 'ChatService' instances based on API key availability.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns an appropriate 'ChatService' instance based on provided stored API key, environment variable, or defaults to a mock service.
